Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, monocytosis, basophilia, elevated ferritin, and a significantly increased INR, suggesting possible coagulopathy. Creatinine is mildly elevated, indicating possible renal impairment. Inflammatory markers (CRP, procalcitonin) are not markedly raised. The findings may indicate acute or chronic hypoxic and inflammatory processes with possible liver or coagulation dysfunction; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
